wordmark.purpose: App name at the top of the rail.

timer.purpose: Elapsed time on the red record block.

caps-head.purpose: Note section heads, stamp first line, writing and failed row titles.

caps-speaker.purpose: Speaker names, the quotes column head, rail day heads.

time-tab.purpose: Clickable times on the note's centre rule.

body.purpose: All reading text: points, quotes, transcript lines, notices.

meta.purpose: Date line, times and durations, counts, Copy button, transcript times.

shadows.name: rail-edge
shadows.purpose: Where the chipboard rail meets the pad; also inset 0 1px 0 above the microphone.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes (140ms background and colour on rows, tabs, quotes) and the land and settle animations.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: A newly arrived transcript line lands heavier and settles.

motion.name: land
motion.purpose: A cited transcript line lands highlighted and settles.

motion.name: run-down
motion.purpose: A 28px stretch of rule runs down the faint rule while a note is written.

motion.name: meter
motion.purpose: Level meter fill, scaled with transform, never width.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All keyframe animations run only when motion is allowed.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Rail 232px, gutter 24px, stamp laid flat and wrapping, search hint hidden.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter rail: less top padding, 44px record button, claim and microphone label screen-reader only.

breakpoints.name: sheet-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Note rows become point | rule | quotes; narrower, quotes fold beneath the point.

narrative.overview:
Evra's main window is a reporter's steno pad. A pale green pad holds the open meeting; a tan chipboard rail owns the left edge with the record control, the meetings by day and the microphone; one deep green rule runs down the middle of the note and the transcript, with the point on one side and the words it came from on the other. Navy ink carries the text. Checking a note takes a glance, because every point and its quote share a row across that rule.

The system is flat and quiet. Colour is laid down as whole areas: a darker green band fills a row when it is hovered, focused, being written or has failed; the selected meeting takes the pad's own colour and merges into it; recording turns the record block red. Type is two faces doing two jobs: condensed capitals for titles, section heads, speakers and labels, and one plain sans for everything that is read. Motion is short and purposeful: what just arrived lands emphasised and settles.

The world runs in light and dark. At night the pad goes almost black-green, the chipboard goes brown, the rule and ink brighten; the roles and structure do not change.
keyCharacteristics: A chipboard rail (264px) beside a pale green pad, no other panels.
One timed centre rule (2px, rule green) drawn row by row, with square detents at section heads and speaker changes.
State shown as filled areas in band greens, never as outlines.
Condensed uppercase display face for structure; Libre Franklin at 15px for reading and 13px for metadata.
Provenance as one rotated rubber-stamp mark.

rules.name: The Red Is Recording Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for recording: the Record dot, the red record block with its meters, and the live pip in the rail. Errors and failures are not red; they fill with Deep Band.

rules.name: The Colour As Area Rule
rules.body: A state fills the whole row or block it applies to (band on hover, focus and writing; band-deep on failure and notices; pad for the selected meeting). It is never a thin coloured border.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Libre Franklin runs at two sizes only: 15px for anything read and 13px for metadata. Hierarchy comes from the condensed caps and from weight, not from more text sizes.

rules.name: The Caps Are Structure Rule
rules.body: The condensed face is always uppercase, bold and tracked (0.05em), and is used for names of things: titles, heads, speakers, labels. It never sets a sentence.

rules.name: The One Rule Rule
rules.body: The centre rule is drawn by every row's middle cell (a 2px rule-green line), so it is continuous across sections and turns. Square 10px detents mark section heads on the note and speaker changes in the transcript.

rules.name: The Flat Pad Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If something needs to stand out, it gets an area of colour or a line, not a shadow.

dos: Do put every note point on the same row as the words it came from, across the 2px rule-green centre rule.
Do show hover, focus, progress, failure and selection by filling the whole row or block (band, band-deep, pad).
Do keep Libre Franklin at 15px/23px for reading and 13px for metadata, and use the condensed bold uppercase face (0.05em) for titles, heads, speakers and labels.
Do use tabular figures for every time, duration and count.
Do keep motion on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) at 140ms for state changes, and wrap anything longer in a reduced-motion check.
Do give every token its dark value under the same name, and check both modes.
donts: Don't use red for anything but recording; errors and failures fill band-deep.
Don't mark state with a thin outline; the only outlines are the focus ring and the rule-green marks drawn in the rule's own line (time tabs, stamp, keyboard hint).
Don't add drop shadows or floating cards.
Don't put a small label above a heading.
Don't add text sizes between 13px and 15px or above 15px for reading text.
